note: Board and go (brief 018 §5), the twin of route-a: the same route to the ambush; then the Enforcer walks Vale to the car as it springs, the three fire until the blocker is down, then board, and the car leaves with the whole cell. Route A, the front door, quiet (GDD §07; Keel N11): watch and listen to Inez, loop the entrance camera, help Inez as often as the card asks (twice: the r016 cast's Inez is Fearful, §04) and have her call the guard away, enter while the door is unwatched, take Vale out by the service door, and fight the rivals' ambush at the getaway car with the whole armed cell (Arms 3). The cell runs where a player in a hurry would (to the café, the cabinet and the door): a run is noticed (Alert 1 at most), which the quiet route can afford.

steps.why: to Inez on the café terrace, at a run

brief 031 (Waymark): to wait on the forecourt 9.8 m from the public door, behind the entrance camera's cone and the patrol's sweep, outside the guard's door cone and more than 3 m from him (2.4 m clear of every cone at any time before 3:20): by the door, in the camera's view until the loop lands, it grew wary of him (29 s; reported at 54 s on the loud route)

brief 031: once beside her (the run is about 7 s; 2 s to spare): the Scout's Watch reaches 30 m, so given at once it would start from the car and leave the walk to her after it; nobody who keeps a clock sees the terrace

steps.label: reroute
steps.why: the idle Tech sends the patrol off its sweep, so the entry needn't wait for a gap

brief 031: once the patrol has left its sweep (the entrance camera is looped by then), from the forecourt to wait by the service end of the west face, 5.6 m south of the public door, out of the guard's cone and more than 3 m from him: nobody who keeps a clock sees him there
the first Help: the card after Listen reads her Fearful, so it says "not yet" (§04: a Fearful person needs Help ×2)

steps.label: turned
steps.why: the second Help, which the card says turns her

steps.label: enter
steps.why: the first moment the door is unwatched: guard away, camera looped, patrol off its sweep

back to the getaway car to cover the extraction; tuning.md §7.9 (the 16 m sidearm, the kite response): to a post by the getaway car the loud route takes, within 15 m of the ambush spots, so the fixer fires from inside his sidearm's reach (from the car's own crew spot the far rivals stood 16-25 m off and the crew no longer broke)

tuning.md §7.9 (the 16 m sidearm, the kite response): to a post by the getaway car the loud route takes, within 15 m of the ambush spots, so the scout fires from inside his sidearm's reach (from the car's own crew spot the far rivals stood 16-25 m off and the crew no longer broke)

the loop is no longer needed once the Enforcer is inside; tuning.md §7.9 (the 16 m sidearm, the kite response): to a post by the getaway car the loud route takes, within 15 m of the ambush spots, so the tech fires from inside his sidearm's reach (from the car's own crew spot the far rivals stood 16-25 m off and the crew no longer broke)

steps.label: hold
steps.why: out of the service door with Vale, to a point 19.5 m south-east of the car, off the rivals' posts by the planters: the ambush springs at 20 m, and the Enforcer holds there while the cell fights
the ambush: the armed cell fires at will

steps.label: out
steps.why: board and go (brief 018 §5): the ambush springs, and the Enforcer walks Vale straight to the car while the three fire; he cannot run or fire
the three cover the Enforcer until he is in and the blocker is down, then go to the car (they board last, brief 018 §2)

once the last board lands (1 s), the whole cell in the car and the car free: it leaves with nobody behind; and not before Vale is in (withdraw.car: with the crew broken sooner from the new posts, the three's boards land before the Enforcer's 4 s)
